title: WEAVE lifecycle state
description: The record of which lifecycle stages have passed, what proved each one, and what the app explicitly does not claim. This file is the lifecycle's own contract: before v1 the weave-v5-apps workspace froze order states, KPI formulas, cohort seeds and negative contracts, but nothing governed the stage record itself — and three apps in one workspace produced three incompatible shapes (ATM-420 defect D5). tools/validate-lifecycle.mjs reads the vocabularies below rather than restating them, so this file is the single source of truth.

schema.description: Schema identifier. weave-cos-lifecycle/v0.1 is accepted for the ATM-415 sealed apps.

current_stage.description: The stage the app is at, or a terminal marker.
current_stage.$comment: Terminal markers vary across the sealed apps (complete vs sealed) — both accepted, see x-weave.terminal_stages.

non_claims.description: What this app does NOT prove. Must include the synthetic-only nonclaim verbatim — see x-weave.required_non_claim.

stage_state.description: not_started: not reached. in_progress: work started, not proven. verified: passed its gate AND has a proof ref that exists on disk. owner_gated_skipped / owner_gated_not_pursued: reached, requires owner access, not pursued (synonyms; both are in the sealed apps). engineering_required: stopped, needs work outside the lifecycle's competence. owner_gate_blocked: stopped, needs an owner decision or access.

x-weave.$comment: Machine-readable vocabulary consumed by tools/validate-lifecycle.mjs. Kept here so the schema and the validator cannot drift apart.

required_non_claim.text: Synthetic cohort only — these KPIs do not prove real demand, real conversion, or real financial performance.
required_non_claim.rationale: ATM-420 and ATM-421 both forbid converting a synthetic cohort result into a real-demand claim. Prose in a procedure cannot enforce that; a required literal in the record can. A state file whose non_claims array does not contain this exact sentence does not validate, so an operator cannot publish KPIs from this lifecycle without the disclaimer travelling with them.

intervention_ledger.rationale: ATM-420 defect D3 — nft-storefront sealed with no ledger, so its intervention count is unrecorded rather than verified-zero. ATM-422's honesty audit depends on these files existing.

freeze_contract.rule: An app with a sealed baseline cohort run must have a non-null frozen_at_commit.
freeze_contract.rationale: ATM-420 defect D1 — that file's own governance note says a baseline run under a null frozen_at_commit is invalid, and nothing enforced it. The freeze is the boundary between building the app and running the experiment.

verdict_contract.rule: A zero or negative conversion delta cannot be recorded as GO. GO requires retest conversion_rate > baseline.
verdict_contract.rationale: ATM-420 defect D7 — sticker-storefront recorded GO on a delta of exactly 0.0, which the frozen verdict_rules do not permit.
